# AutoWalk

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** Auto Walk, AutoWalk

## What it does

AutoWalk holds your forward movement key for you, so your character keeps walking in whatever direction you're looking without you needing to touch the keyboard. Turn it on, point your camera where you want to go, and you'll keep moving forward; turn your view and you turn your path.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/player/autowalk). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
